ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity region covering the right lobe and fluke-peduncle junction; high-intensity region centered on the left lobe with distal black mottling and linear pixel interruptions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and a high depth-to-width bounding box ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; right lobe trailing edge features a prominent, low-frequency concave excision (notch) near the mid-point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve observed along leading edges; complex concave curves along trailing edges converging at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular dark-on-white pixel groups situated in the central-left fluke lobe area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel sets of unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white field of the left lobe at approximately 45-degree angles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major physical trauma indicated by a large semicircular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; widespread linear abrasions across both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique jagged, high-contrast pigmentation boundary located at the transition between the left lobe and the central fluke body.
